say:1:1430232401:1.text: Taleon wants me and my family to pay for a part of the wedding! That wasn't in our deal!
say:1:1430232401:1.source_cn: 塔里恩要我和家族支付一笔婚礼的费用，可我们之前商谈并没...
say:1:1430232401:1.male: Taleon wants me and my family to pay for a part of the wedding! That wasn't in our deal!
say:1:1430232401:1.female: Taleon wants me and my family to pay for a part of the wedding! That wasn't in our deal!

say:3:1430232402:1.text: This shall compensate for the decline of our noble standing. Noble titles in Sal'thorin are mere relics of the past now.
say:3:1430232402:1.source_cn: 这笔费用是贵族影响力的折损费，毕竟如今萨洛克兰的贵族头...

say:4:1430232403:1.text: Since you're so worried about compensation, let me be clear. There won't be a wedding anymore!
say:4:1430232403:1.source_cn: 既然你这么精打细算，那么我也明确告诉你——不会再有什么...
